page.notes: Printed text is mostly clear. Long s was read as s throughout; the form "fuæ" and similar words were read with long s and given as plain s. Doubtful spots: "fatendum", "ufuveni-re", "fuperbam", "facilora" and "fuae" are read from a small scan and may be wrong. "patrisfamiliás" has an accent mark that may be a mark rather than a letter. A small mark centred below the text is probably a gathering signature; it is not a clear letter, so it is left out. Small dashes and dots at the left edge of the text are ink flecks, not notes.
